scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @oc3/shared && npm run typecheck -w @oc3/gateway && npm run typecheck -w @oc3/control-center
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @oc3/shared && npm run lint -w @oc3/gateway && npm run lint -w @oc3/control-center
scripts.build: npm run build -w @oc3/shared && npm run build -w @oc3/gateway && npm run build -w @oc3/control-center
